svg.text: One hue from gray to vivid: WLab and CIELAB
Each row is one lightness. Chips run from gray (left) to the most vivid color that fits
on screen (sRGB). For gamut mapping, a row should keep one hue as it gets more vivid.
Each row sits on the gray of its own lightness. CIE 1931 observer, D65. Both planes pass through
the lightest of the most vivid WLab chips. Screen colors are approximate.
